project.name: ${project.groupId}:${project.artifactId}
project.description: Renders a Receipt through a Qute template, as HTML or PDF: the shared, portable (no CDI) presentation layer on top of microchain-api's receipt types -- usable server-side and, eventually, by mchain/bindle (client) alike. Split out of microchain-api so that consumers who don't render receipts (e.g. commit.java) don't inherit the qute-core/openhtmltopdf dependencies.
